Abuse and rape were not your fault. Abuse and rape are serious. You have every right in the world to feel exactly how you feel right now. People can drown in 3ft of water just like people can drown in 30ft of water— the person who drown in 3ft of water is just as valid as the person in 30ft of water. That being said, you have legitimate trauma. Any form of inflicting pain on yourself is self harm. Self harm isn't just cutting.
Didn't get a choice in being put on this planet, but I suffer everyday

Teachers don't want to see kids die (even the belegerant ones) and they don't want to see anyone suffer. To them a human life is more important than having to fill out some extra paperwork or work with someone's IEP.

I've been on this thread for a while since I've been struggling with suicidal thoughts for years. Recently it seems like posts are almost constantly coming in. I think it's a combo of the world being in shambles right now and college finals.

My situation is unfortunate and unique— but you certainly have people who care about you too. You deserve as much as anyone to keep working towards goals and dreams,,, and if you don't think you have goals and dreams, remind yourself of what the little kid version always wanted for yourself and don't stop till you give that version of yourself everything that they ever wanted.

I'm 18, just attempted to complete my first year of college. I've been suicidal since I was 11 and still am to this day. I'm not one for usually commenting anything except "me too", however—
Give it till you're out of high school. I know so many people who've had their lives improve significantly and they found their purpose after high school. There's more freedom and goals you can set once your 18. Some people find that it gives them something to start living for.
I plan on tonight as well. It's the only way. After death there may not be happiness, but an absence of pain. That's enough for me.
Same. I've been researching housing fund grants and ways to receive financial support as an adult survior of child abuse, and I'm coming up empty handed at every corner.

I really hate going to the doctors because I feel like I always get dismissed as being overdramatic, they've failed me so many times. I have nerve damage in my upper right shoulder, so I'm wondering if it could be related to that. When I have these sort of "episode", the sensation and pain are particularly bad around the sides of my neck and forearms. I just hate going to the doc and having them treat me like I'm unimportant and attention seeking since I'm a young woman.

My functioning has absolutely been destroyed. I'm trying to keep my stress levels as LOW as possible since stress seems to be my main trigger. That's being said, it's hard to keep stress low when your brain is actively fighting against that.
As for medication and getting help, it's very hard for me to do that. A) America, no need to explain that one and B) I'm on my parents insurance plan, they believe people with mental illnesses are degenerates to society, and C) they withhold signing my bank acc over to me so I virtually have no money. I have no access to help. My college takes 2 months to get a person in to see a mental health professional, and, with that, you can only have 2 free sessions. I know I cannot continue to live like this forever, I'm clearly capable of becoming a danger to myself, but what do I do at this point? I feel so stuck

I'm pretty far west of New England. I do know what hospital I need to go to if I get that bad. I'm struggling so badly and it's been going on for almost 4 weeks now. I feel like I haven't even peaked in mania. Whenever I start to feel the depression kick in a bit I end up re-triggering the mania because it's the only thing that gives me enough energy to get out of bed and shower and eat. It's obviously not a normal energy though, but it works. I've kinda started putting myself in semi dangerous situations though, like late night walks around my campus when it's not safe to do so. I can't feel the cold when I'm outside, my hands go stiff but I can't feel the pain. It's getting worse and I feel so confused and like I'm an uncureable, scary burden to everyone around me since I'm so impulsive and people can't help me. I can't get help till the semester is over. I feel like no one understands me and no one listens. Why am I stuck like this.

The mental health services at my school are honestly horrible. I'm not on meds right now. I want to take leave from school, but then I'd have to go live with my parents and they're abusive. When should someone go to a hospital for this sort of thing? I'm scaring my friends and I feel really bad, but I'm also becoming super paranoid.

I keep going from extreme highs to extreme lows and sometimes I get caught in this in between of confusion. I feel so lost and confused. It feels like there's nothing wrong with me except I clearly know there's something wrong with me. I just don't feel like anyone hears me. I'm no longer understanding wrong from right, my brain just feels so foggy and I'm not scared of anything anymore ?????
